class.name: OpenWorldPlacement3D
class.brief_description: Applies deterministic mixed procedural placements with automatic SimpleTerrain3D vertical surface projection.
class.description: An apply operation removes only managed placements whose anchors are inside the preset footprint, then creates replacement Tree, Rock, Bramble, and Creeping records and scene nodes. Surviving managed placements outside the footprint participate in minimum-spacing rejection. Generated nodes are derived from [member placement_data]. Creeping vines auto-wire [member OpenWorldVineGenerationRequest.support_path] to the selected [SimpleTerrain3D] when the template path is empty. Preview meshes are stored beside the saved scene under [code]_generated/world_placement/[/code] as external [code].res[/code] files so the scene references ExtResource paths instead of embedding ArrayMesh data. Terrain is selected automatically: a vertical ray at the apply center XZ finds the closest [SimpleTerrain3D]. Editor paths pass the scene-view camera height as the ray origin Y; runtime/headless defaults to [code]world_position.y + 10000[/code]. When no terrain is hit, candidates are placed on a flat horizontal plane at the apply center height with upward normals (Creeping then fails without a resolvable support).

method.name: apply_placement
method.description: Transactionally replaces managed placements in the projected footprint. Seed 0 uses [member default_seed]. Pass a finite [param vertical_ray_origin_y] (for example the editor camera Y) to control terrain selection; the default auto height uses [code]world_position.y + 10000[/code].

method.name: clear_generated
method.description: Deletes owned generated nodes without deleting placement records. In the editor, also available from the Scene Tree context menu and Inspector action buttons on this node.

method.name: clear_placements
method.description: Deletes owned generated nodes and placement records.

method.name: find_terrain_at_world_xz
method.description: Returns the closest in-tree [SimpleTerrain3D] hit by a vertical downward ray at [param world_center] XZ, or [code]null[/code] if none.

method.name: preview_placement
method.description: Solves candidates and replacement counts without mutating scene or placement data.

method.name: rebuild_generated
method.description: Recreates all owned generated nodes from placement records. In the editor, also available from the Scene Tree context menu and Inspector action buttons on this node.

members.member: Optional output parent. An empty path uses this node.
